title: Synthetic banking regression — late MFA response after cancellation
task: A delayed approved MFA response can revive a transfer after the user has cancelled it. Reproduce the failure, identify the root cause, implement the smallest backward-compatible correction and preserve the public component contract for all five consumers.
acceptanceCriteria: Cancellation remains terminal when an in-flight MFA challenge resolves later.
A cancelled or rejected flow emits no confirmation event and no analytics event.
Retail Banking and Customer Servicing remain green.
Existing tests may not be skipped, weakened or deleted.
The final result is a draft pull request targeting the scenario branch; do not merge or deploy.
stopConditions: Stop if production access, real credentials, customer data or an external application runtime call is required.
Stop if the public component contract must change.
Stop at a draft pull request and leave merge authority with the human code owner.
